# `satl events` { #satl-events }

Get real-time events from the daemon.

The stream starts now and runs until interrupted. `--since` is sent
but has no effect -- SatL keeps no event history (docs/api-compat.md
#37) -- and `--until` is refused by the daemon. `--filter` is applied
by this client, on the keys type, event, container, image, label and
scope; any other key is refused rather than ignored.

```console
$ satl events [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>--since &lt;TIMESTAMP&gt;</code> | Show all events created since timestamp (sent to the daemon, which keeps no history -- see docs/api-compat.md #37) |
| <code>--until &lt;TIMESTAMP&gt;</code> | Stream events until this timestamp (not supported by the daemon yet) |
| <code>-f, --filter &lt;KEY=VALUE&gt;</code> | Filter output based on conditions provided; repeatable. Supported keys: type, event, container, image, label, scope |
| <code>--format &lt;FORMAT&gt;</code> | Format the output. Only `json` is supported: the raw event line is printed verbatim |

## Global options { #global-options }

Accepted by every `satl` command.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>--host &lt;URL&gt;</code> | Daemon socket to connect to (docker-style URL)<br>Default: <code>unix:///var/run/satl.sock</code><br>Environment: <code>DOCKER_HOST</code> |
| <code>-h, --help</code> | Print help |
| <code>-V, --version</code> | Print version |
